description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractExpression which is part of the Twig templating engine. It provides common functionalities for expression nodes within the Twig syntax tree, including handling attributes like 'is_generator' and 'with_parentheses'.

classes.name: AbstractExpression
classes.description: An abstract class representing expression nodes in Twig's syntax tree, providing methods to check for generator attributes and explicitly set or check for parentheses around expressions.

methods.name: isGenerator
methods.description: Returns true if the expression node is marked as a generator by having the 'is_generator' attribute set.

methods.name: setExplicitParentheses
methods.description: Sets the 'with_parentheses' attribute to true, indicating that the expression should be rendered with parentheses explicitly.

methods.name: hasExplicitParentheses
methods.description: Checks whether the 'with_parentheses' attribute is set and true, indicating explicit parentheses around the expression.
